description: Every data-centre project our pipeline tracker lists in one European market, latest stage first: name, stage, stated MW, the date it was last checked and its page. Needs a personal DC Blueprint key (Authorization: Bearer) from an account with a DC Blueprint licence or trial. The market costs 1 credit; the same list again in the calendar month costs nothing. A list longer than 25 projects comes in pages (the "page" argument).
